labels.name: compare_llc_costs
labels.description: Rank states by what an LLC actually costs. Compares the one-time formation fee, the recurring state cost, and the combined first-year total. Use this for 'cheapest state to form an LLC' style questions rather than guessing.

labels.name: get_annual_report_deadline
labels.description: Work out when a state's annual report or franchise tax is next due, the amount owed, and the late penalty. States that key the deadline to the formation anniversary or quarter need formationDate; without it the tool says so instead of guessing a date.

labels.name: check_llc_name
labels.description: Check a proposed business name against a state's live registry. REAL results for Wyoming and Delaware only; Florida returns a Sunbiz search link; all other states return unsupported. A verdict is an indication, never a reservation — always show the returned note and verifyUrl.

labels.name: list_filing_states
labels.description: What FilingDesk can do per state: which states it files in today with all-in pricing, which states have real name-checking, and confirmation that fee/deadline data covers all 50 states + DC. Call this before telling a user FilingDesk can file somewhere.

labels.name: compare_formation_options
labels.description: Factual tradeoffs to help someone decide WHERE to form or WHAT entity type to pick. Returns fixed comparative facts and a required disclaimer — deliberately NOT a recommendation. Present the options neutrally, relay the disclaimer, and let the user choose; a FilingDesk specialist confirms the choice

labels.name: preview_order
labels.description: Build an exact order summary WITHOUT submitting anything. No side effects. Validates the details, prices the order, and returns a confirmation summary. ALWAYS call this and show the user the returned summary before calling submit_order.

labels.name: submit_order
labels.description: Submit a real formation order to FilingDesk. THIS HAS A REAL-WORLD EFFECT: it creates an order and notifies a FilingDesk specialist. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_llc_name" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "preview_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_llc_fees · Private data: list_filing_states · Public sink: submit_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_llc_fees · Private data: list_filing_states · Public sink: submit_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
